<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>The Soul Beauty Studio — Indore</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  :root {
    --cream: #FAF6F0;
    --blush: #E8C5B0;
    --rose:  #C4896A;
    --deep:  #3D2218;
    --gold:  #B8965A;
    --charcoal: #2A2A2A;
    --mist:  #F3EDE5;
    --serif: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    --sans:  'Jost', sans-serif;
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--charcoal);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ─── NAV ─── */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 1.4rem 4rem;
    background: rgba(250,246,240,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(184,150,90,0.15);
    transition: padding .3s;
  }
  nav.scrolled { padding: .9rem 4rem; }

  .nav-logo {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--deep);
    letter-spacing: .04em;
    text-decoration: none;
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .nav-logo span { display: block; font-size: .7rem; font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: .25em; color: var(--gold); text-transform: uppercase; }

  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2.4rem; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a { font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--deep); text-decoration: none; position: relative; }
  .nav-links a::after { content:''; position: absolute; bottom:-3px; left:0; width:0; height:1px; background: var(--gold); transition: width .3s; }
  .nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

  .nav-cta {
    background: var(--deep);
    color: var(--cream);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .72rem;
    letter-spacing: .18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: .7rem 1.8rem;
    border: none; cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background .3s, transform .2s;
  }
  .nav-cta:hover { background: var(--rose); transform: translateY(-1px); }

  /* ─── HERO ─── */
  #hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  .hero-bg-img {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center top;
    display: block;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .hero-overlay {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(20,8,4,0.82) 0%, rgba(20,8,4,0.65) 55%, rgba(20,8,4,0.25) 100%);
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .hero-left {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
    padding: 10rem 5rem 6rem 8rem;
    position: relative; z-index: 2;
    max-width: 680px;
  }

  .hero-eyebrow {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .72rem;
    letter-spacing: .3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp .8s .3s forwards;
  }

  .hero-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 6rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.0;
    color: var(--cream);
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp .9s .5s forwards;
  }
  .hero-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--rose); }

  .hero-sub {
    margin-top: 1.8rem;
    font-size: .95rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.9;
    color: rgba(250,240,230,0.8);
    max-width: 400px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp .9s .7s forwards;
  }

  .hero-actions {
    margin-top: 2.8rem;
    display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; align-items: center;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp .9s .9s forwards;
  }

  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--deep);
    color: var(--cream);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .75rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 1rem 2.4rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all .3s;
    display: inline-block;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--rose); transform: translateY(-2px); }

  .btn-ghost {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .75rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--cream);
    text-decoration: none;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem;
  }
  .btn-ghost::before { content: ''; width: 28px; height: 1px; background: var(--gold); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--blush); }

  .hero-badge {
    margin-top: 3.5rem;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fadeUp .9s 1.1s forwards;
  }
  .stars { color: var(--gold); font-size: .9rem; letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .badge-text { font-size: .78rem; color: rgba(250,240,230,0.7); font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: .04em; }
  .badge-text strong { color: var(--cream); font-weight: 500; }



  /* ─── MARQUEE ─── */
  .marquee-bar {
    background: var(--deep);
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: .85rem 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .marquee-track {
    display: inline-flex;
    animation: marquee 20s linear infinite;
  }
  .marquee-item {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .7rem;
    letter-spacing: .25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--blush);
    padding: 0 2.5rem;
  }
  .marquee-dot { color: var(--gold); }

  @keyframes marquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

  /* ─── SECTION BASE ─── */
  section { padding: 7rem 0; }
  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 4rem; }

  .section-eyebrow {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .7rem;
    letter-spacing: .3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4vw, 4rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--deep);
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .section-title em { font-style: italic; color: var(--rose); }

  /* ─── ABOUT ─── */
  #about { background: white; }
  .about-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 6rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .about-visual {
    position: relative;
  }
  .about-card {
    background: var(--mist);
    aspect-ratio: 3/4;
    display: flex; align-items: flex-end;
    padding: 2.5rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .about-card-bg {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, #D9C4B5 0%, #C4907A 60%, #A06050 100%);
  }
  .about-card-text {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 2.2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    color: white;
    line-height: 1.2;
    text-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  }
  .about-accent {
    position: absolute;
    top: -20px; right: -20px;
    width: 160px; height: 160px;
    border: 1px solid var(--gold);
    opacity: .4;
    z-index: 0;
  }
  .about-accent2 {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 20px; left: -30px;
    width: 100px; height: 100px;
    background: var(--blush);
    opacity: .35;
  }
  .about-content { }
  .about-lead {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--rose);
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .about-body {
    font-size: .9rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 2;
    color: #5A4A42;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .about-features {
    margin-top: 2.5rem;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1.2rem;
  }
  .feature-pill {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem;
    padding: .9rem 1.2rem;
    background: var(--cream);
    border-left: 2px solid var(--gold);
    font-size: .78rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: .06em;
    color: var(--deep);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .feature-pill::before { content: '✦'; color: var(--gold); font-size: .6rem; }

  /* ─── SERVICES ─── */
  #services { background: var(--cream); }
  .services-intro {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end;
    margin-bottom: 4rem;
  }
  .services-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 2px;
  }
  .service-card {
    background: white;
    padding: 3rem 2.5rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1);
    group: true;
  }
  .service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); }
  .service-card::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0; left: 0;
    width: 0; height: 3px;
    background: var(--gold);
    transition: width .5s cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1);
  }
  .service-card:hover::before { width: 100%; }
  .service-number {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--blush);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
  .service-name {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 1.6rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--deep);
    margin-bottom: .8rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }
  .service-desc {
    font-size: .84rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: #7A6A60;
    margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
  }
  .service-items {
    list-style: none;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--mist);
    padding-top: 1.2rem;
  }
  .service-items li {
    font-size: .76rem;
    letter-spacing: .08em;
    color: var(--deep);
    padding: .4rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mist);
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .service-items li span { color: var(--gold); font-weight: 500; }

  /* Full-width feature service */
  .service-feature {
    grid-column: span 3;
    background: var(--deep);
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    min-height: 300px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .service-feature-content {
    padding: 3.5rem 3.5rem;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
  }
  .service-feature .service-number { color: rgba(184,150,90,.3); }
  .service-feature .service-name { color: var(--cream); }
  .service-feature .service-desc { color: rgba(250,246,240,.6); }
  .service-feature-visual {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5A3020 0%, #3D2218 100%);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .feature-ornament {
    width: 240px; height: 240px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(184,150,90,.3);
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  }
  .feature-ornament::before {
    content: '✦';
    font-size: 3rem;
    color: var(--gold);
    opacity: .6;
  }

  /* ─── EXPERIENCE ─── */
  #experience { background: var(--deep); overflow: hidden; position: relative; }
  .exp-bg-text {
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%; left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 18rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,.025);
    white-space: nowrap;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .exp-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
  }
  .exp-stat {
    padding: 3.5rem 2.5rem;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    text-align: center;
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
  }
  .exp-number {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 3.5rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: .5rem;
  }
  .exp-label {
    font-size: .72rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(250,246,240,.5);
  }
  .exp-quote {
    grid-column: span 4;
    padding: 4rem 3rem;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    text-align: center;
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
  }
  .exp-quote blockquote {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--cream);
    line-height: 1.5;
    max-width: 700px;
    margin: 0 auto 1rem;
  }
  .exp-quote cite {
    font-size: .75rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-style: normal;
  }

  /* ─── REVIEWS ─── */
  #reviews { background: white; }
  .reviews-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 4rem; }
  .reviews-overall {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem;
    margin: 1.5rem 0 .5rem;
  }
  .reviews-score {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 5rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--deep);
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .reviews-stars { font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--gold); letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .reviews-count { font-size: .8rem; color: #9A8A80; letter-spacing: .1em; }
  .reviews-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1.5px;
  }
  .review-card {
    background: var(--cream);
    padding: 2.2rem;
    position: relative;
  }
  .review-card::before {
    content: '\201C';
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 5rem;
    color: var(--blush);
    position: absolute;
    top: 1rem; right: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .review-stars { color: var(--gold); font-size: .85rem; margin-bottom: .8rem; }
  .review-text {
    font-size: .88rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.8;
    color: #5A4A42;
    margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .review-author {
    font-size: .72rem;
    letter-spacing: .15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--deep);
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .review-date { font-size: .68rem; color: #A09090; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: .05em; }

  /* ─── BOOKING ─── */
  #booking { background: var(--mist); }
  .booking-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 5rem;
    align-items: start;
  }
  .booking-content .section-title { margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .booking-info {
    margin-top: 2.5rem;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem;
  }
  .info-item {
    display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .info-icon {
    width: 40px; height: 40px; min-width: 40px;
    background: var(--deep);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: .85rem;
  }
  .info-detail {}
  .info-label {
    font-size: .68rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: .2rem;
  }
  .info-value {
    font-size: .88rem;
    color: var(--deep);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .booking-form {
    background: white;
    padding: 3rem;
  }
  .form-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--deep);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
  }
  .form-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
  .form-group { margin-bottom: 1.2rem; }
  .form-group label {
    display: block;
    font-size: .68rem;
    letter-spacing: .18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--rose);
    margin-bottom: .5rem;
  }
  .form-group input,
  .form-group select,
  .form-group textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: .85rem 1rem;
    border: 1px solid #E8DDD5;
    background: var(--cream);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .88rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--deep);
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color .3s;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
  }
  .form-group input:focus,
  .form-group select:focus,
  .form-group textarea:focus {
    border-color: var(--gold);
  }
  .form-group textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 100px; }
  .form-submit {
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--deep);
    color: var(--cream);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .75rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 1.1rem;
    border: none; cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: .5rem;
    transition: background .3s;
  }
  .form-submit:hover { background: var(--rose); }
  .form-note {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: .73rem;
    color: #A09080;
    margin-top: .8rem;
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  /* ─── FOOTER ─── */
  footer {
    background: var(--deep);
    padding: 5rem 0 2.5rem;
  }
  .footer-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 4rem;
    margin-bottom: 4rem;
  }
  .footer-logo {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--cream);
    line-height: 1.1;
    margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .footer-logo span {
    display: block;
    font-size: .62rem;
    font-family: var(--sans);
    letter-spacing: .3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-top: .3rem;
  }
  .footer-tagline {
    font-size: .84rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: rgba(250,246,240,.45);
    line-height: 1.8;
    margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
  }
  .footer-social {
    display: flex; gap: .8rem;
  }
  .social-btn {
    width: 36px; height: 36px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(184,150,90,.3);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: .7rem;
    color: var(--gold);
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all .3s;
  }
  .social-btn:hover { background: var(--gold); color: var(--deep); }
  .footer-col h4 {
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: .68rem;
    letter-spacing: .25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 1.4rem;
  }
  .footer-col ul { list-style: none; }
  .footer-col li {
    font-size: .82rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: rgba(250,246,240,.55);
    padding: .35rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);
    transition: color .2s;
    cursor: default;
  }
  .footer-col li:hover { color: var(--blush); }
  .footer-bottom {
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    padding-top: 2rem;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  }
  .footer-copy {
    font-size: .72rem;
    color: rgba(250,246,240,.3);
    letter-spacing: .05em;
  }
  .footer-mark {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: .9rem;
    color: var(--gold);
    letter-spacing: .15em;
    opacity: .6;
  }

  /* ─── SCROLL REVEAL ─── */
  .reveal {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(32px);
    transition: opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1), transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1);
  }
  .reveal.visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
  .reveal-delay-1 { transition-delay: .1s; }
  .reveal-delay-2 { transition-delay: .2s; }
  .reveal-delay-3 { transition-delay: .3s; }
  .reveal-delay-4 { transition-delay: .4s; }

  /* ─── ANIMATIONS ─── */
  @keyframes fadeUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  /* ─── FLOATING BOOKING BTN ─── */
  .float-book {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 2rem; right: 2rem;
    background: var(--deep);
    color: var(--cream);
    font-size: .7rem;
    letter-spacing: .2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: .9rem 1.8rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    z-index: 99;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(61,34,24,.25);
    transition: all .3s;
    display: none;
  }

<!-- FLOATING CTA -->
<a href="#booking" class="float-book" id="floatBook">Book Now ✦</a>

<script>
  // Nav scroll
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 60);
    document.getElementById('floatBook').classList.toggle('visible', window.scrollY > 400);
  });

  // Scroll reveal
  const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });
  reveals.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));

  // Form handler
  function handleSubmit() {
    const btn = document.querySelector('.form-submit');
    btn.textContent = 'Request Sent! We\'ll be in touch ✦';
    btn.style.background = 'var(--gold)';
    btn.style.color = 'var(--deep)';
    setTimeout(() => {
      btn.textContent = 'Send Request ✦';
      btn.style.background = '';
      btn.style.color = '';
    }, 4000);
  }
</script>
